title: Survey of India Official All India District Boundaries
source_organization: Survey of India / Ministry of Panchayati Raj
spatial_coverage: National / All India (742 Districts; 33 Chhattisgarh Districts)
crs: Lambert Conformal Conic (LCC_WGS84; reprojected to EPSG:32644)
limitations: Pre-dates late 2022 bifurcation of 5 newest districts; partitioned in WP1 pipeline

title: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR Ground Range Detected
limitations: Speckle noise; revisit interval 12 days; radar shadow/layover in hilly fringes

title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A Harmonized
limitations: Dense monsoon cloud cover; shadow contamination requires SCL masking

title: Local Government Directory District Boundaries
source_organization: Ministry of Panchayati Raj / Survey of India
limitations: Boundary changes in 2022 require exact LGD code matching (not legacy names)

title: ESA WorldCover 10m Land Cover v200
limitations: Static snapshot from 2021; does not capture within-year crop rotation

title: IMD High Resolution Daily Gridded Rainfall
limitations: Coarse spatial resolution; interpolates sparse rain gauges in Bastar division

title: NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission DEM 30m
limitations: Static topography; cannot resolve field-level bund heights (< 0.5m)
usage_in_pipeline: Topographic slope masking for rice suitability

title: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance / State DAC&FW
source_organization: Directorate of Economics and Statistics GoI / GoCG
limitations: Reporting lag of 1-2 years; newly formed 6 districts often reported aggregated
